about: Seeded history for the stats research run (2026-10-15). 16 weeks + this week of the real A/B Split, Mon/Wed/Fri, alternating A/B. Missed week of 10 Aug (holiday); one session in week of 14 Sep (sick). Warm-ups on squat and deadlift; ramped working sets on squat (w-15, w-5, w, w) and deadlift (w-10, w, w). DB bench press plateaus at 14 kg from late July. Assisted pull-ups go from BW-27 towards less assistance. Hyper-extension turns loaded (BW+5) in the last 2 B sessions. RIR logged from the 11th session (Track effort on). Rules mirror src/domain: warm-ups never count; e1RM = Epley w*(1+r/30), best per session; muscle sets 1 primary + 0.5 secondary.

sessions.label: Fri 3 Jul
sessions.note: Gym crowded, did push-ups on the floor.

sessions.label: Fri 2 Oct
sessions.note: Left shoulder a bit tight on bench.
